concepts.name: 01-signal-fork
concepts.title: 信号分路
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original AgentSwitch macOS and iOS app icon concept, a single standalone square 1024x1024 master artwork. Product: a native developer tool for remotely orchestrating multiple AI agents on a Mac from an iPhone; its visual language is pixel / character / signal, restrained cyber glitch. Art direction: deliberate bold geometric silhouette, impeccable optical centering, broad legible shapes at small app-icon sizes, quiet negative space, sharp architectural edges with tiny grid-based steps. Foreground occupies approximately the central 64 percent of the canvas, all critical details inside central 76 percent. Square full-bleed opaque background edge to edge. The operating system will supply its own outer corner mask, so do not draw a rounded square tile, outer border, device, presentation board, label, typography or watermark. No huge 3D extrusion, no glossy toy aesthetic, no complex circuitry, no hacker skull, no robot, no terminal >_ symbol, no padlock. Glitch must be a small number of intentional horizontal offsets and crisp chromatic fringes affecting less than 8 percent of the symbol, never obscuring its recognition. The image is a finished clean icon, not a sheet of icons.
Concept: SIGNAL FORK. Preserve the product's original metaphor: one square input node on the left feeding exactly three separate output square nodes vertically aligned on the right. One bold pixel-stepped upper route is active and luminous warm white #E9E6DF with a small signal-pink #FF2E88 accent at its output; middle and lower routes are clearly visible muted warm gray. A compact, beautifully balanced routing glyph made of rectilinear horizontal lines and stepped diagonal transitions, large enough to recognize instantly. Background nearly black #08090B with extremely subtle graphite tonal depth, no decorative patterns. A tiny pink and cyan #2EE6FF channel misregistration at just two horizontal slices of the main white route, and one isolated pixel fragment, add restrained cyber glitch. One very shallow hard-edged shadow gives the glyph slight depth, no fuzzy glow. Premium native app identity, minimal and precise.

Concept: GLITCH SWITCH. A strong custom letter-S-like switching glyph made of two interlocking thick angular signal paths, each with one square terminal node; it should read first as a bold compact S-shaped signal switch, second as two opposite transfer paths. Avoid a dollar sign and do not add any letters. Use a warm-white #E9E6DF main silhouette with a single vivid pink #FF2E88 inner connection on a full-bleed almost-black #09090C background. Two very short horizontal glitch slices subtly displace the silhouette, with a razor-thin cyan #2EE6FF echo and a pink one-pixel fringe. The silhouette remains solid and simple, with generous squared negative space and only a few stepped pixel corners. Very slight shallow material relief and sharp edges, no glow cloud. Bold graphic symbol with Apple app-icon clarity and hacker-terminal personality.

Concept: RELAY CORE. A minimal routing hub seen exactly front-on. One central bold square core, separated by clean negative-space gutters from three large short bracket-shaped ports (left, top-right, bottom-right), with just three strong right-angle links suggesting one controller dispatching to multiple agents. The entire silhouette should feel like an original compact geometric emblem, not a circuit board diagram or a four-arrow navigation icon. Full-bleed warm off-white #F3F1EA background. Main geometry charcoal #151413; one active square port and its short route vivid signal pink #E0106E. A tiny cyan #2EE6FF and pink registration fault crosses only one narrow horizontal band through the core; two small shifted square fragments maximum. Refined matte surface, almost-flat shallow hard shadow, abundant clean whitespace. Sophisticated daylight Apple icon with restrained cyber-glitch edge.

Concept: PIXEL HANDOFF. Two bold pixel-stepped open bracket paths curl into each other diagonally, like a compact square link / relay loop transferring a single square packet between two agents. The overall silhouette is a strong symmetric diamond-like interlock made from orthogonal thick strokes, all horizontal/vertical with stepped corners, not a chain illustration and not a generic infinity sign. One path warm white #E9E6DF and the other vivid pink #FF2E88, separated by crisp dark negative space. A tiny cyan #2EE6FF square packet at the exact center conveys the handoff. Full-bleed deep black #06070A background with extremely faint graphite shading. Add only two intentional thin glitch offsets at opposed edges, with small pixel cuts and a subtle chromatic fringe. Clear weighty silhouette, restrained shallow depth, beautifully balanced as an Apple app icon, no busy detail.
